title: Verification Execution Orchestration & End-to-End Pipeline Enforcement
baseline_phase: M9-C48 Capability Operationalization & Verification Control Plane

execution_plan_contract.description: Machine-readable execution plan with all required fields (plan_id, fingerprint, ordered tasks, dependencies, evidence, authorization, timeout, failure policy). Deterministic from C48 control plane.

execution_orchestrator.description: Consumes C48 ControlPlanePlan, dedupes by command, injects revalidations for stale/missing measurement records, executes in dependency order, captures structured records, applies stop rules.

stop_on_sufficiency.description: All mandatory tasks PASS or REUSED → skip escalation tasks. Mandatory FAILED → diagnostic path. TIMEOUT/INFRASTRUCTURE/SCOPE never convert to PASS. AUTHORIZATION_REQUIRED stops at the boundary.

mutation_subordinate.description: Mutation revalidation is a single capability among many. Requires explicit --authorize. Never auto-executes a full campaign. Uses native mutmut runner + C47 measurement truth.

evidence_reuse.description: Persistent measurement records checked before execution. Current + certifiable → REUSED. Stale → revalidation injected. Missing → revalidation injected.

observability.description: Every task produces a structured TaskExecutionRecord persisted to runtime/generated/m9-c49/. CLI exposes execution-plan, execute, execution-status, execution-report.

shared_impact_resolution.description: C48 'endpoint/capability resolution incomplete' gap closed: deterministic AST-based dependency index for shared modules + planner vocabulary bridge (useLoansCapability → loan-engine).

acceptance_scenarios.description: 16/16 acceptance scenarios A–M + determinism + stop-on-sufficiency + plan validation pass.

regression_suites.description: 219 pre-existing tests pass (C42.27–31, measurement_truth, survivor_intel, affected, cross_layer_planner, snapshots). No production code deleted. No parallel architecture introduced.
regression_suites.evidence: runtime/tests/test_m9_c42_27..31, test_measurement_truth, test_survivor_intel, test_affected, test_cross_layer_planner, test_snapshots

modules_added.purpose: C49 core: ExecutionPlan, ExecutionOrchestrator, structured records, stop rules, final decision, diagnostic + authorization boundary
Deterministic AST-based shared-module dependency index (closes C48 endpoint/capability gap for shared infrastructure changes)

modules_extended.purpose: Added PLANNER_CAPABILITY_ALIASES, shared-impact index integration, capability_sources + unmapped_blast_capabilities to CapabilityResolution
Added 4 CLI commands: execution-plan, execute, execution-status, execution-report

known_boundaries: Full mutation campaigns remain explicit escalation (never auto-executed)
Coverage revalidation for non-required-for-certification mappings is non-mandatory
Frontend knowledge capability IDs with no verification-registry mapping are recorded in unmapped_blast_capabilities and excluded
verify.py env-check is the canonical pre-flight; orchestrator runs it implicitly via verify_prerequisites
